description: Per-identity advisory poll-freshness relation. checked_at is the retained recorded check date used for poll freshness; legacy rows, including an unverified SDK reference, do not establish successful baseline/contract verification. Future date advances require supported reverification of the specific reference and scope, not merely a successful fetch. pinned_version retains a deliberately selected reference or snapshot. Optional pin_kind, latest_observation and review_disposition distinguish retained authority from newly observed evidence. Observation metadata never refreshes checked_at, adopts a version or establishes compatibility; pending and indeterminate dispositions remain visible. Currency is offline, read-only and advisory. SLA resolution and existing status semantics are unchanged. See docs/currency/README.md.
$comment: 2026-06-12 [9k5h.10]: terminology — the former 'bounded-staleness window' framing is now the advisory 'poll-freshness SLA' (same datum, honest name: it is a polling-attention SLA, not a consistency bound, and it gates nothing). Renamed pins to lab-registry surface ids: 'mcp-spec' -> 'mcp-spec-docs', 'claude-code' -> 'claude-code-changelog' ('agentskills-spec' already matched). Added one pin per remaining registry surface (13 new; 16 registry pins total) + kept the 3 internal-contract pins (skill-md-schema, gate-result-predicate, anthropic-sdk). The per-pin 'class' field is an additive, backward-compatible v1 extension (window resolution: explicit staleness_window_days > class SLA > default_staleness_window_days), so no pins.v2.json bump is needed.
